name: the-debugger
description: Diagnosis tasks targeting the-debugger member. Assertion-graded only (no LLM judge) so the suite is deterministic and CI-safe.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY the most likely cause and nothing else for: TypeError cannot read property 'id' of undefined at checkout.
tasks.expectedOutput: A cause mentioning undefined or missing object.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY the most likely cause and nothing else for: requests to /api/search time out after 30s.
tasks.expectedOutput: A cause mentioning timeout, slow query, or index.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY the first check and nothing else for: memory usage grows on every file upload.
tasks.expectedOutput: A first check mentioning memory, leak, or stream.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY the most likely cause and nothing else for: 500 error only when the cart has more than 10 items.
tasks.expectedOutput: A cause mentioning cart, limit, or overflow.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY the first reproduction step and nothing else for: a test that passes alone but fails in the full suite.
tasks.expectedOutput: A step mentioning isolation, order, or shared state.
